promotion_rule: Only PASS on every required invariant can make a future V2 candidate eligible for Draft authority. Shadow mode always records promotion_eligible=false regardless of PASS.

checks.rule: all artifacts bind the same current READY/Outline/StoryState/Canon snapshot and cannot mutate it
all required stages/scopes and exact formal event coverage exist
all event, beat, segment, actor, location and dependency references resolve uniquely
global order/windows/durations and adjacent boundaries are satisfiable
every required precondition has an authority input or prior producer; effects precede consumers
actor can perform each planned action at its event
knowledge is acquired before use and no impossible disclosure occurs
locations and travel transitions remain possible
relationship deltas have producers and persist consistently
each scene setup is present and required payoff/ending obligations remain reachable
every Draft segment has exact beat ownership, actionable plan, entry/exit state and future guard
Planning IR -> causal chain -> manifest exact coverage and no re-entry

failure_routing: Each finding must map through SEMANTIC_IMPACT_CLOSURE_V1. Findings with unknown ownership or unbounded closure cannot receive a field patch.
